issues.detail: Preparation of 23 is referenced to Chem 2025, 11, 102440 (reference 16a); not reported step-by-step in this article/SI. Routes explicitly start at 23.
Only formal synthesis: experimental route stops at 40; 40 to deoxoapodine is a two-step literature link (reference 20). No fabricated observed reactions.
Main article and Scheme 1 use (+), while SI S7-S9 uses (-), with measured rotation -70.0 and ent-3 reference +110.4. Optical sign not resolved by SMILES.
SI S10 reports [M+H]+ C22H31N2O2 at 255.2380/255.2370; formula predicts approximately 355.2380. Preserve original numbers; flag probable 100 Da typo.
Scheme 4 specifies DMF; SI S23 specifies CH2Cl2 as reaction solvent. Structured conditions use experimental SI and preserve conflict.

reactions.notes: One-pot sequence; no isolated yield or drawing for the two internal states.
SI reports flash purification of the dialdehyde; article says no column purification. Preserve both claims.
Shared transformation repeated in preparations of 1 and 2; impure with Ph3PO, no standalone yield. Hemiaminal C5 epimerization is reported.
Article calls product (+); SI calls it (-) and reports negative rotation. Structure is transcribed from the drawing without resolving the textual sign conflict.
31 is an isolated N-substitution side product, not a subsequent step.
Inseparable mixture, ratio approximately 2.6:1 by NMR.
One mixture experiment, two separately isolated products. Inputs are co-processed, not coupled.
Shared transformation repeated for 33 and 36; Ph3PO-contaminated material. No standalone yield; C5 configuration unspecified.
SI procedure solvent CH2Cl2 conflicts with DMF in Scheme 4.
Phenylselenide is carried crude; newly introduced stereochemistry is unspecified.
Desilylation and cyclization are reported as one operation; free alcohol is not isolated.
Endpoint of work actually performed here. The two steps from 40 to 12 belong to reference 20, not this paper.
